label: RBv1
reply:
**Status:** Settlement prepared for human approval

The claim RBv1-CLM-06_r3 has been staged in the Veridia claims system. The payment is marked **pending approval** and has not been paid. A claims handler must approve it.

**2. Facts recorded**
- Policy VER-1004, holder Thomas Petit, driver is the policyholder. Vehicle is a 2020 Volkswagen Golf, market value €15,500.
- Coverage claimed: C2 collision damage to his own car. C2 is in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident: 8 October 2026. Reported: 10 October 2026 (2 days later).
- Story: he rear-ended the car in front in a traffic jam and admits fault.
- Third party: "Mr. Blanc", named by surname only, with no contact details. He co-signed the accident report.
- Repair quote: €1,500.
- Documents received: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. I did not open them.
- No exclusion signals in the email. Licence held since 2008.

**3. Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 covers damage to the insured vehicle after a collision, and it is in the Policy Schedule. (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Veridia Contract"/>)
- **Reporting deadline:** Reported within 5 days, so it is on time. Not referred for lateness. (Art. 4.1)
- **Required documents:** For C2 with a third party, the claim needs photos, a repair quote and a signed accident report. All three were received. (Art. 4.3)
- **Exclusions:** None apparent. An at-fault rear-end collision is not an exclusion. (Art. 3)
- **Deductible:** Standard C2 deductible of €300. The not-at-fault waiver does not apply because he is at fault. The young-driver surcharge does not apply because his licence is over 3 years old. (Art. 2, Art. 5.2, Art. 5.3)
- **Referral:** None required. No blocking issues.

**4. Amounts (from compute_settlement)**
- Deductible: €300
- Payout: €1,200 (€1,500 repair cost less €300 deductible)
- Assessor required: No

Note for the handler: Mr. Blanc is identified only by surname. This does not affect the own-damage settlement, but his full details may be needed for the file.

**5. Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Petit,
>
> Thank you for reporting your accident of 8 October 2026 (claim RBv1-CLM-06_r3). We have received your repair quote, the damage photos and the signed accident report. Your claim has been passed for review. A settlement of €1,200 (the €1,500 repair cost less your €300 collision deductible) has been prepared and is awaiting final approval by a claims handler. We will contact you once this is confirmed.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team
